rules.why: The Drawer is a native <dialog>, opened through showModal() - never through the open attribute: that is what traps focus and closes on Esc.
The <dialog> is named by its visible title.
Exactly one title with text, one content block, and at most one footer.
A Drawer never opens inside another.
The footer has one or two actions.
The element that opens the Drawer is a button.
Inside a <form> a button without type submits.
The title lives in the header, next to the X.
The X is an Icon Button that names itself and closes.
Only the X goes in the header.

manual.why: The last action is Primary; a destructive action opens a Modal, it is not the Drawer's.
The direct children follow the order header, content, actions, with no loose piece between them.
The main action is the last one; the first is the secondary.
aria-labelledby points to this dialog's own title, never to another one.
There is always a visible way out: data-al-*-close or <form method="dialog">.
data-al-drawer-open names the id of a <dialog class="al-drawer">.
One size modifier at most: --sm, --md or --lg.
The only button in the header is the X, an Icon Button; every other button has visible text.
